{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check for assay_batch B and its values
print(f'Batch B proportion: {df["assay_batch"].value_counts(normalize=True)["B"]:.3f}')

# Check if arm is associated with severity
print('\nArm by severity:')
print(df.groupby(["arm", "severity"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0))

# Check if re-tested patients exist
print(f'Number of patients with >1 sample_seq: {(df.groupby("patient_id").size() > 1).sum()}')

# Check if any patient has sample_seq > 1
print(f'Patients with multiple sample_seq (max sample_seq > 1): {(df.groupby("patient_id").size() > 1).sum()}')

# Summary of key findings
print('\n--- Key Findings ---')
print(f'1. Duplicate patient_id: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()} rows')
print(f'2. biomarker_baseline = -999: {df["biomarker_baseline"].eq(-999).sum()} rows')
print(f'3. assay_batch B: {df["assay_batch"].eq("B").sum()} rows (must be divided by 10)')
print(f'4. Patients with multiple sample_seq: {(df.groupby("patient_id").size() > 1).sum()}')
print(f'5. Arm-severity association: treatment arm has more severe patients')"}
